class_guess: Bouncer with period-20 bulk and unresolved irregular boundary
summary: A 20-cell periodic region coexists with a much larger irregular region whose compressed description grows.
mechanism: The 100-million-step snapshot has 274 consecutive copies of a 20-cell word. The long-run image shows a regular left region and irregular material extending toward the right.

With periods through 64, the 1m, 10m and 100m snapshots require 104, 267 and 866 tokens. This measured growth makes a small fixed collection of bulk-length counters less plausible than for the other candidate; it does not prove chaos.

The block-20 qsim reached 8,156,594 exact steps with no rules in 100,000 macro loops. Its endpoint agrees with a direct C rerun. Direct C simulation separately reached 100 million steps without a halt.
